dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Yates River area (NTS 84N/NE) (polygon features). The data are created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the polygon features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 552, Surficial Geology of the Yates River Area (NTS 84N/NE).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Yates River Area (NTS 84N/NE) (GIS data, polygon features)
